'''Pokémon: The Master Quest''' is the opening theme song for the {{pmin|Italy|Italian-language}} dub of the [[S05|fifth season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from [[EP210]] to [[EP262]].

The opening animation featured footage from the fifth English opening, [[Believe in Me]], and clips from various episodes of the season.
